constraints: run_authorized ONLY if TASK-20260801-026 records APPROVAL_DETERMINATION APPROVED; otherwise cancel with no run and say so. The CALIBRATION_AUTHORIZATION at TASK-20260801-020 does NOT authorize this run.

EXECUTE THE IDENTICAL DRIVER FILE WITH NO EDIT OF ANY KIND (ATS-1 clause 5). Record the driver sha256 in the manifest; if it differs from the DRIVER_SHA256 bound by the TASK-20260801-022 calibration snapshot receipt, STOP AND REPORT - that is CTRL-EQD-DRIVER-HASH failing and it invalidates the real run outright.

Enumerate i < j only, at exactly n = C(512, 2) = 130816 per arm. A short arm is reported short and is never padded, imputed or extrapolated. Any recorded c_2 = 0 draw on any arm is an integrity failure - stop and report it.

The real factor base is the frozen deterministic subset - the first 512 x-coordinates in F_p, in increasing integer order, that are x-coordinates of points of E(F_p). Record factor_base_sha256 over the canonical decimal newline-joined x-list.

The matched null must draw from the REAL-ARM null stream 2301 + 50000 + bits, disjoint from every calibration stream, must maintain 512 DISTINCT x-coordinates by reject and redraw, and must record the rejection count and its x-list sha256.
THE NULL PIPELINE MUST DIFFER FROM THE REAL PIPELINE IN THE SOURCE OF THE 512 POINTS AND IN NOTHING ELSE. Record that fact and how you ensured it.

CTRL-EQD-S3 IS MANDATORY - for the first 1000 half-tuples in enumeration order per cell, verify by ACTUAL POINT ARITHMETIC on E(F_p), through a code path that does not reuse the coefficient formula, that the root multiset of f_ij equals {x(P_i + P_j), x(P_i - P_j)}, and record verified over total. Anything below 1000 of 1000 at either cell stops the run.
CTRL-EQD-RANGE IS MANDATORY - assert and record that every e_1 and e_2 lies in [0, p) and that every arm has exactly 130816 pairs.
PC-1 and DV-7 are CONTROLS AND NOT EVIDENCE. Run them, record them, and do not describe either as bearing on H-EQD-001 or HEUR-DS-1. DV-7's non-rejection is expressly NOT corroboration of anything.
Record the real-arm admissible-support fraction, which must be exactly 1.0, and every stream hash.

The run manifest is manifest.yaml, NOT manifest.json, with companions command.txt, environment.json, stdout.log, stderr.log and raw-result.json - NOTE THE .log RATHER THAN .txt - and result.certificate.kind must be the literal string none, because no discrete logarithm and no decomposition is claimed.

NO FACTORIZATION, NO SMOOTHNESS STATISTIC, NO DICKMAN EVALUATION, NO SEARCH ARM, NO CLAW TABLE, NO RELATION HARVEST, NO TIMING DECISION VARIABLE, NO COST IDENTITY AND NO R anywhere in the package. wall_seconds_total is recorded for budget accounting only.

Do not read-modify, import, edit or stage any file under experiments/EXP-DS-001/ or experiments/EXP-SMTH-001/.
Timeouts, crashes, memory exhaustion and budget cancellation are infrastructure signal, never mathematical negatives (AGENTS.md rule 5).
No new dependencies. MAKE NO COMMIT; TASK-20260801-028 archives.
